prohibitions: No retained JATS, PDF, media, supplement, abstract text, or protected benchmark bytes in Git
No full-text request before article-level reusable-rights, retraction, relevance, and version checks pass
No inference of canonical target population from a vague elite/professional label

required_record_fields.candidate_benchmark_families: array of frozen RES-21 family IDs F01-F14
required_record_fields.candidate_capabilities: array of frozen RES-21 capability IDs C01-C18
required_record_fields.license: article/version-specific deterministic license classification, canonical identifier, exact PMC front-matter raw href/ref/text, request/response evidence digests, and preserved historical registry value.
required_record_fields.license_identifier_source: PMC OAI front matter locator or explicit reason not checked
required_record_fields.performance_level: array of reported level descriptors; no inference from elite/professional alone
required_record_fields.pmc_article_version_identity: PMCID, PMCID version identifier, OAI identifier and datestamp
required_record_fields.pmc_jats_article_type: string|null; article/@article-type from PMC front matter/JATS
required_record_fields.population: structured reported cohort summary; unknown values remain explicit
required_record_fields.protocol_device_method: reported protocol/device/method facts with source locators
required_record_fields.retraction_correction_expression_of_conc: status and source-bound related notice identifiers
required_record_fields.source_family_identity: stable source-family ID with clustering basis and unresolved cross-document links explicit
required_record_fields.title: string

rights_authority.required_evidence: Exact full CC BY 4.0 URI equality in PMC article-version license/@xlink:href or ali:license_ref; explicit attribution wording; no restrictive terms; exact PMCID/version/PMID and case-insensitive DOI identity match. Prefix matching is prohibited.

source_authority: RES-115; PMC article-level metadata and JATS for article/version-specific rights and identity
